summary: FieldSnap Pro v1.5 – Circular Image Overlay feature verified. Source review of /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx confirms every requirement: (a) Tool union extended with 'overlay' (line 49); (b) OverlayEl { id, type:'overlay', cx, cy, r, uri } added to Element union (lines 73-74); (c) TOOL_LIST ends with overlay button using icon 'add-circle-outline' & label 'Overlay' (line 87); (d) hitTest overlay case uses Math.hypot(px-cx, py-cy) <= r (lines 123-124); (e) moveElement overlay case shifts cx, cy (lines 148-149); (f) renderElement overlay case uses <Defs><ClipPath id=`clip-${id}`><Circle .../></ClipPath></Defs> then <SvgImage href={{uri}} clipPath=`url(#..)` preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid slice' /> then a border Circle (white 2px normal / blue 3px when selected) plus SelectionHalo (lines 1153-1182); (g) SelectionHalo overlay case renders dashed Circle at r+6 stroke rgba(140,200,255,0.9) strokeDasharray '6 4' (line 1216); (h) Pinch onUpdate reads selectedOverlayInitR.value; when >0 computes nextR = clamp(20, displayed.w*0.9, initR*e.scale) and calls runOnJS(resizeOverlayRef.current)(nextR), else scales the canvas as before (lines 233-242); onEnd resets selectedOverlayInitR to 0 (line 253); (i) useEffect syncs selectedOverlayInitR to selected overlay's radius or 0 (lines 593-601); (j) resizeSelectedOverlay updates the current history frame in place and is stashed on resizeOverlayRef.current (lines 603-613) — this ref pattern fixes the previous TDZ ('Cannot access resizeSelectedOverlay before initialization'); (k) addOverlay lazy-requires expo-image-picker, requests media library permission, launches image library, and on success inserts a new OverlayEl at (displayed.x+w/2, displayed.y+h/2) with r=min(displayed.w, displayed.h)*0.2, calls pushHistory, sets Select tool + selectedId, and toasts a hint (lines 615-652); (l) Toolbar Pressable dispatches to addOverlay when t.tool === 'overlay' (lines 822-825). Live web-preview UI test (390x844) confirms: editor route loads with a sample photo URI param, tool-overlay testID present in toolbar (rightmost, bbox ~x=767, y=724) with correct 'Overlay' label; all 9 tool testIDs (tool-select, tool-marker, tool-text, tool-notes, tool-circle, tool-arrow, tool-rectangle, tool-freedraw, tool-overlay) render; header right-group order is editor-zoom-reset → editor-undo-button → editor-header-save-button (save now occupies Redo's former last slot in a blue accent circle); editor-redo-button is ABSENT. Tapping tool-overlay triggers addOverlay() and shows an 'Overlay …' toast (path is exercised — native ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync cannot fully open a native picker on web preview, expected). Home, Gallery, Observation, Settings, Privacy, Help, About routes all load with ZERO page errors and ZERO console errors. TDZ bug from previous iteration is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: editor.tsx is now 1392 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting SelectionHalo, renderElement, hitTest/moveElement, and gesture composition into separate modules for maintainability.

resizeSelectedOverlay mutates history[historyIdx] in place (line 609) so pinch resize is NOT undoable step-by-step — the entire pinch session ends up as a single history entry. If step-wise undo of resize is desired, capture on pinch onEnd instead of every onUpdate.
addOverlay uses `require('expo-image-picker')` lazily which is fine for web, but on Android/iOS the first pinch will re-import the module every time addOverlay is invoked. Non-blocking.

package.json versions slightly outdated per Expo doctor warnings (expo 54.0.34 vs 54.0.36, expo-font 14.0.11 vs 14.0.12, expo-router 6.0.23 vs 6.0.24). Not blocking but flagged by Metro on every start.
seed_data_creation: Used https://picsum.photos/seed/fieldsnap/1080/1440 as a stand-in image URI to reach the editor route on web.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://field-docs-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 390x844. Reach editor without gallery: navigate directly to `/editor?uri=<image_url>&width=1080&height=1440`. Overlay feature verified via testID presence + tap dispatch — end-to-end insertion cannot be tested on web because expo-image-picker native library requires a device. Pinch-to-resize logic likewise requires two-finger gesture unavailable in headless browser; verified via source. All other editor toolbar testIDs and header controls confirmed present. No runtime/red-screen errors on any route.
